assessment: Five-year test: passes. The thesis rests on a 2016-2024 spine (WUNC 2016, Allure 2020, Harper's Bazaar 2021, A24 Podcast and Awards Focus 2021, OC Register 2023, Call Her Daddy and GQ 2024). Removing the October 19, 2026 ELLE interview and the May 31, 2026 Euphoria finale leaves the hook, the Type 3 hearing and the discriminator intact; the recent material deepens the argument (the 'flatter answer' arc, the perception quote) without carrying it. Nearly all dates in the body are absolute and ages are computed correctly. The exposure is concentrated in a few present-tense status claims (Blade Runner premiere in body and FAQ, residence, the Fike 'no response' line, 'now describes') and in the evidence record, where C01, C33, C79 and C98 are time-bound but marked stable with empty review_triggers; the five claims that are flagged time_sensitive (C31, C37, C38, C50, C99) all carry actionable triggers. One absolute claim ('only writing credit Levinson has shared on the show') is sourced to pre-final-season material and needs verification or anchoring. Similarity advisory not tripped (max 0.033 against a 0.04 threshold); the top pairs are ordinary Type 4 vocabulary in the type-answer section, not reused argument, and the only generic stretch is the short 'pattern goes in a few plain steps' paragraph. The age FAQ is correctly dated 'as of October 2026' with a trigger. Body is 3,990 words against a 4,500 release ceiling, so repairs should be substitutions rather than additions.
